summary: Audit NUQD app + backend for every remaining mock/gap and design one prioritized plan to make it fully real and advanced

items.currentState: getPortfolio() returns a REAL end-total but a fabricated curve: it takes the seeded mock series PORTFOLIO_SERIES[range] and rescales it so only the last point equals the real total. Every historical point on the Home/Wallet line chart is invented noise; the 1H/1D/1W/1M/1Y/All shapes are all the same 6 mock seeds. Only changeUsd/changePct (24h, holdings-weighted) are real.
items.realReplacement: Backend must record portfolio valuation snapshots (a balances-x-price time series) and expose e.g. GET /api/me/portfolio/history?range=; the app then plots the true curve. No such endpoint exists today — needs a scoped backend addition (periodic snapshot job or on-the-fly reconstruction from swaps/deposits/withdrawals + historical prices).

items.currentState: avgCost is fake. In real mode api.ts anchors avgCost to the current live price so per-asset and total P&L read ~0; in mock mode it uses seeded avgCost (e.g. BTC 41800). Wallet's 'Unrealized P&L', 'Total invested', and each asset's '+/-$ (%)' row are therefore fabricated, not derived from actual buy prices.
items.realReplacement: Backend needs cost-basis tracking (weighted-avg or lot-based) computed from the ledger's swap/deposit history, surfaced on /api/me (per-asset avgCost + realized/unrealized P&L). Then Wallet shows true P&L. Requires a backend addition — the swaps table has from/to amounts but no cost-basis rollup yet.

items.currentState: placeOrder() calls /api/me/swap directly and never calls the existing /api/me/quote. The 0.5% FEE_RATE, the 'Rate' (shown as spot price), 'You receive', and 'Network: NUQD instant' are all computed client-side and cosmetic; no minToAmount is sent so there is no slippage protection, and the success screen shows locally-computed units, not the swap's actual r.toAmount. Real executed amount (with server spreadBps=50) can differ from what was shown.
items.realReplacement: Call apiQuote(from,to,amount) to display the real rate/fee/received before confirm, pass minToAmount into apiSwap for slippage protection, and render r.toAmount/r.fee/r.rate from the swap response on the receipt. All endpoints already exist (/api/me/quote, /api/me/swap).

items.currentState: NETWORK_FEE is a hardcoded cosmetic map ({crypto:2.4, token:0.9, stablecoin:0.5}) shown as 'Estimated network fee' and added into the displayed Total, but apiWithdraw() sends fee implicitly '0' to the backend, so the fee shown is neither real nor charged.
items.realReplacement: Fetch a real network-fee estimate (per-asset) from the backend and pass it as the withdraw fee, or read the fee the backend actually applies and display that. Backend withdraw accepts a fee param but the client hardcodes none.

items.currentState: Earn is entirely non-functional 'coming soon'. EARN_POSITIONS = [] always, so getEarn/getPortfolio earning is $0; APY_TIERS and TOP_EARNING rates (up to 14%) are hardcoded marketing numbers; the 'Notify me' button only flips local state. Home's Earn summary card is a static 'Coming soon' string, and getPortfolio.availableUsd == totalUsd because earning is always 0.
items.realReplacement: Needs a real (hedged, CBB-compliant 'designed to' framed) earn/staking product on the backend: subscribe/redeem endpoints, accrual, and positions on /api/me. Until then the hardcoded APYs should be labelled indicative (they are) but there is no backend behind any of it.

items.area: KYC status never surfaced / no verification flow
items.currentState: me.kyc {kyc_tier, sanctions_clear, frozen} is fetched by apiMe but never read in the UI (grep confirms zero consumers). The Identity screen hardcodes 'Verified · Level 2', the profile shows a hardcoded BadgeCheck 'Verified' and 'Identity verification: Verified', regardless of the real tier. There is no tier0 'verification in review' gate UI and no way to start KYC — a tier0 user just hits a raw 'KYC required to trade' error on Trade/Send. The reference backend web app shows a proper pending-review banner; this app doesn't.
items.realReplacement: Read me.kyc: show real tier/frozen state on Profile + Identity, gate Trade/Send with a friendly 'verification in review' state for tier0, and add a KYC-submission flow (a real KYC provider adapter, or at minimum surface the demo AUTO_KYC/admin-approve path). Backend already tracks and enforces tiers.

items.currentState: All three Security toggles only flip Zustand booleans persisted to localStorage (default biometrics:true, twoFactor:true, transactionPin:false). Nothing enforces them: no WebAuthn/passkey biometric unlock, no TOTP/2FA challenge on login (backend auth is password + session token only), and the transaction PIN is never requested before any trade/send. They are pure cosmetic switches.
items.realReplacement: Real 2FA needs a backend TOTP enrol/verify flow gating /api/login; biometric unlock needs WebAuthn/passkey registration; transaction PIN needs a stored PIN hash checked before withdraw/swap. None exist server-side yet — each is a scoped backend addition.

items.currentState: The form validates strength/match locally and shows 'Password updated' without ever calling the backend — there is no change-password endpoint and the current-password field is ignored. Passwords are not actually changed.
items.realReplacement: Add POST /api/me/password (verify current, set new via the existing scrypt auth) and call it from this screen.

Nothing is persisted or earned.
items.realReplacement: Needs a backend rewards/quests service (points ledger, task completion events, referral attribution) exposed on /api/me. Currently no backend at all.

The TopBar rewards/notifications unread dots are always-on decorations, not driven by real unread counts.
items.realReplacement: Back tier/loyalty with a real fee-tier/loyalty model and referral program on the backend; drive quick-stats from real account data (joined date is available in backend customerDetail but not on /api/me); drive the TopBar unread dot from me.notifications.unread.

Home's 'Add funds' just routes to /trade (a crypto buy), and real funding only happens via the 'Add test funds' simulated-custody credit on Receive. There is no fiat deposit/withdrawal rail at all.

items.realReplacement: Wire the form to POST /api/me/support and list existing tickets via GET /api/me/support (add these to lib/client.ts). Endpoint exists; app just doesn't call it.

items.realReplacement: Add backend notification producers for price alerts (ties to the dormant priceAlerts setting) and product news; format timestamps relatively. Deposit/withdraw/swap/kyc notifications are already real.

items.realReplacement: Optionally reconcile display prices with the backend's market source (or at least be aware limit checks use backend prices); wire apiMarket where backend-authoritative valuation matters.

unusedEndpoints.capability: Server-Sent Events stream scoped to the logged-in customer (openStream/broadcast in server.ts:129-149). The backend already pushes an event whenever that customer's state changes: deposit credited (nuqdApp.simulateDeposit + live chain watcher), swap complete, withdrawal approved/settled, KYC/freeze change, new notification. Includes a 25s heartbeat and auto-cleans on disconnect.
unusedEndpoints.appGap: The app has zero real-time. lib/client.ts:apiMe uses a 6s cache and only refreshes on manual mutation/invalidateMe; the notification bell, balances, portfolio total and activity list never update live. An EventSource on /api/me/events would drive live re-fetch of apiMe(force) on every backend state change (e.g. staff approves a withdrawal, a deposit confirms) with no polling.

unusedEndpoints.capability: Returns the customer's own support tickets with full threaded message history, status (open/pending/resolved/closed) and priority. Internal staff notes are filtered out server-side (support.ts:39). Ownership-scoped so no cross-customer leakage.
unusedEndpoints.appGap: The 'Contact support' screen (app/(stack)/settings/support/page.tsx) is 100% cosmetic: the form onSubmit merely sets sent=true, and the channel buttons are dead. There is no ticket list, no history, no status. A real in-app Help Center / My Tickets view is fully backed but unbuilt.

unusedEndpoints.capability: Opens a real support ticket (subject + body) that lands in the staff Support portal (support.html), can be assigned, prioritized, replied to, and escalated into a compliance case. Broadcasts to staff SSE.
unusedEndpoints.appGap: The support form persists nothing and never reaches staff. Wiring this powers an actual 'raise a ticket' flow from the app with a tracked case number.

unusedEndpoints.capability: Customer reply within a ticket thread; reopens a resolved/closed ticket and notifies staff. Enforces ticket ownership.
unusedEndpoints.appGap: No threaded support conversation UI exists. This endpoint would power a two-way chat/message thread per ticket (the app currently fakes 'Live chat, replies in minutes').

unusedEndpoints.capability: Register named withdrawal destinations ahead of time. NuqdApp.allowlist supports a 24h cooling-off (active_from = now()+interval; nuqdApp.ts:158-165) that blunts account-takeover drain attacks; the risk engine also scores 'new_destination'/'account_takeover' against allow-list age (riskEngine.ts:182-195).
unusedEndpoints.appGap: The app calls allowlist automatically with immediate=true right before every withdrawal (client.ts:117), so there is no 'Saved addresses / Address book' screen and the anti-ATO cooling-off protection is silently bypassed. A managed withdrawal-address book (add address -> cooling-off countdown -> then withdrawable) is fully supported but absent.

unusedEndpoints.capability: The swap engine enforces an optional slippage floor: if the oracle-priced net received amount drops below minToAmount it rejects with 'slippage: would receive less than minimum'. client.ts:apiSwap already accepts the minToAmount parameter and forwards it.
unusedEndpoints.appGap: placeOrder never passes minToAmount (api.ts:387 calls apiSwap(fromCore, toCoreId, fromAmount) with no floor), so every buy/sell/swap executes with no slippage protection and no 'max slippage' control in the trade UI.

unusedEndpoints.endpoint: Withdrawal lifecycle states already in GET /api/me withdrawals[].status
unusedEndpoints.capability: The backend runs a 9-state withdrawal machine (requested/screening/pending_approval/approved/signing/broadcast/settled/rejected/failed) and returns the live status per withdrawal in /api/me (server.ts:258).
unusedEndpoints.appGap: realActivity() collapses all of that into pending/completed/failed (api.ts:196-198), so the customer never sees 'in AML screening', 'awaiting approval', 'broadcast, N confirmations', or a rejection reason. A real withdrawal status timeline is available with no new endpoint (the app just discards the granularity).

The live DepositWatcher + Evm/Btc/Solana adapters already exist (server.ts:80-91) but have nothing real to watch. Add a keyless (watch-only xpub) address-derivation service that populates deposit_addresses with real testnet addresses per user per chain, so Receive shows valid QR-able addresses and real testnet deposits credit through the watcher.

missingForReal.backendNeeded: There is no GET /api/me/withdrawals/:id or /api/me/tx/:id; NuqdApp.withdrawalStatus (nuqdApp.ts:219) is unrouted and /api/me's withdrawals query omits chain_tx_hash, rejection_reason, risk_score, approvals_needed. Add a detail route that selects those columns (all already stored in the withdrawals/swaps/deposits tables) to power a tx-detail screen: status timeline, on-chain tx hash (explorer link), fee, usd_value at time, approvals, and rejection reason.

Add a ramp provider seam + POST /api/me/ramp/quote, a signed ramp webhook that credits BHD through the ledger (external -> user_available), and a BHD bank-payout withdrawal path.

missingForReal.backendNeeded: auth.ts is password + server-side session only; no 2FA, and the risk engine flags that credential-change tracking is an unwired seam (riskEngine.ts:301 lastCredentialChangeMs: null). Add user_totp(user_id, secret, enabled), enroll/verify/disable endpoints gating login and withdrawals, a sessions/devices management view (sessions table already exists), a password-change endpoint that records a credential-change timestamp (feeding the risk engine's SIM-swap/ATO signal).

features.name: Real-time balance & order-status push (SSE)
features.description: Push balance/withdrawal/swap/deposit state changes to the app instantly instead of the current 6s polling cache, so the wallet and activity update live as staff act or chain events land.
features.reason: Backend already implements a per-customer SSE stream at GET /api/me/events (nuqd-core/src/app/server.ts:232) and calls broadcast({customerId}) after every deposit/swap/withdraw/KYC/freeze (server.ts:274-289, 326-348). The app never subscribes; lib/client.ts:84 apiMe just short-caches for 6s. Fix is frontend-only: open an EventSource, call invalidateMe()+reload on each event. No backend change.

features.name: Real P&L / cost-basis tracking
features.description: Show true unrealized/realized gain-loss per holding and portfolio-wide, based on actual acquisition cost, not a placeholder.
features.reason: lib/api.ts:108-109 explicitly anchors avgCost to the live price so P&L renders ~0 rather than a fabricated number — the comment says 'No cost-basis tracking server-side yet'. The data to compute it already exists: swaps carry from_amount/to_amount/fee/rate/usd_value (sql/003_advanced.sql) and deposits carry amount (sql/001_schema.sql). Add an average-cost engine + /api/me endpoint that folds swap+deposit history into per-asset cost basis. No gated infra.

features.name: Portfolio value chart over time (real history)
features.description: The Home hero chart should plot the account's actual historical USD value across 1D/1W/1M/1Y, not an illustrative shape.
features.reason: getPortfolio (lib/api.ts:130-132) takes the mock PORTFOLIO_SERIES curve and merely rescales it to end at the real current total — the whole line except the last point is fake. There are no historical balance snapshots server-side. Add a daily balances snapshot table + snapshot job (or reconstruct by valuing journal_entries at historical prices) and a /api/me/history endpoint. Pure data work, no mainnet/custody dependency.

The app only collapses status into pending/completed/failed in the activity list (lib/api.ts:195-197) with no detail/timeline screen. Data is present; build the view (optionally add a per-withdrawal GET for the full audit timeline).

plan.summary: "Fully real + advanced" for NUQD means: every screen reflects the real custodial ledger and the user's real KYC/session state, all money math and status come from the backend (not client-side cosmetics), the app updates live, and the few genuinely mock features (Earn, portfolio-history chart, cost-basis P&L, price alerts, in-app KYC, 2FA) get scoped backend additions — all under the hard constraint that custody stays simulated/testnet-only with no mainnet funds and no guaranteed-yield language. Recommended build order: (1) cheap high-impact WIRE-UPS of capabilities the backend already has but the app ignores — SSE real-time, real quote+slippage in Trade, support ticketing, real session identity, real KYC tier + gate, scannable QR, CSV export, live price refresh, withdrawal-status timeline, change-password; these deliver the biggest 'this is real' jump for days of work, not weeks. (2) SCOPED BACKEND ADDITIONS that remove the remaining fabrications — portfolio snapshots (real chart), cost-basis (real P&L), price alerts, KYC tier limits, in-app KYC submission, 2FA/TOTP, session management, address-book cooling-off. (3) LARGER features that round out a wealth app — recurring buys, real testnet deposits, simulated Earn accrual, multi-currency, referral/rewards, limit orders, passkeys. Order within each tier is by value/effort with dependencies first (SSE underpins support/alerts/withdrawal-status; KYC-surface precedes KYC-limits/submission; TOTP precedes passkeys). EXPLICITLY DEFERRED as needs-infra (excluded, keep as waitlist/coming-soon): the NUQD Card program (needs a BIN sponsor/issuer-processor + PCI + licence) and the fiat BHD on/off-ramp (needs a licensed PSP/bank + CBB approval) — the in-scope funding paths are simulated 'add test funds' now and real testnet crypto deposits later; and live third-party IDV vendors (Onfido/Jumio) behind the in-app KYC flow (build the flow + provider seam now, integrate the vendor when licensed)."
